title: The social sense: susceptibility to others' beliefs in human infants and adults.
central_claims: Adults and infants automatically encode another agent’s belief, affecting object-detection responses.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: The adult reaction-time contrast reproduced: r=.586, p<.001, N=95. Independent artifact tests show this behavioral contrast does not securely identify automatic belief representation.

source_manifest.title: A Second Look at Automatic Theory of Mind: Reconsidering Kovács, Téglás, and Endress (2010)
source_manifest.finding: Thirteen experiments reproduce behavioral effects but attribute them to attention-check timing; controlled tests do not support automatic belief computation. Original abstract and results description read.
